title: Two defects in the instruction files themselves (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md)
description:
Found by the prose review of 2026-11-26 and verified directly. Left for
Mark: these are the files the agents operate under, and one is machine
generated, so I did not edit either.

## 1. CLAUDE.md tells agents to run a command AGENTS.md forbids

CLAUDE.md line 48, inside the managed Beads block, under
"Team-maintainer opt-in only":

    git pull --rebase

AGENTS.md line 147: "Never `pull --rebase`, reset or force-push."

So an agent reading both files is instructed to do the thing the
repository prohibits. Verified by reading both lines.

The block looks machine-generated (it carries a `profile:minimal`
marker), so a hand edit would be regenerated away. The fix belongs
wherever `bd` generates it, or in a repo-side override.

## 2. AGENTS.md cites a ruleset that does not exist

AGENTS.md line 3: "Mark's global rules in `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` and
`~/.claude/standards/rust.md` also apply".
AGENTS.md line 105: "## Rust conventions (in addition to rust.md)".

Neither file exists. `~/.claude/` holds backups, cache, feedback,
file-history, history.jsonl, paste-cache and projects, and no CLAUDE.md
and no standards/ directory.

So "also apply" has been unfollowable, and the five bullets under "Rust
conventions" are silently the whole Rust standard rather than an
addition to one. Either restore the files or stop citing them.

## 3. CLAUDE.md is mostly a second copy of AGENTS.md

CLAUDE.md ends with `@AGENTS.md`, and its own first 58 lines restate the
Beads block that AGENTS.md already carries -- one pair
("**Architecture in one line:**") byte-identical. A session therefore
reads the same rules twice. Two of its three "Agent Context Profiles"
cannot apply here (nothing opts into team-maintainer; "minimal" is
defined as keeping instruction files as pointers, which this file is
not), and the marker says `profile:minimal` while the prose declares
"Conservative (default)".

Suggestion from the review: CLAUDE.md should be a pointer to `bd prime`
plus `@AGENTS.md`. Again, machine-generated, so fix it at the source.
close_reason: Fixed in 230c1b4e. CLAUDE.md's managed block removed with bd setup claude --remove (the documented mechanism; a hand edit inside a hashed block would be regenerated), so the git pull --rebase that AGENTS.md forbids is gone, as are the three profiles and the duplicate load. CLAUDE.md is seven lines pointing at AGENTS.md; AGENTS.md's own generated Beads section carries the guidance and no git policy, so pull --rebase appears once in the repo, in the rule forbidding it. The citations of ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md and ~/.claude/standards/rust.md are dropped: neither exists anywhere under the home directory, so an agent was told about rules it could not read. If global rules are wanted they have to be created and named.
